heading.en: Helaman recounts the taking of Antiparah and the surrender and later the defense of Cumeni—His Ammonite striplings fight valiantly; all are wounded, but none are slain—Gid reports the slaying and the escape of the Lamanite prisoners. About 63 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua faamatala mai e Helamana le aveina o Anetipara ma le toilalo ma le puipuiga mulimuli ane ai o Kumenae—Ua tau ma le totoa lana autalavou sa Amonā; ua manunua uma, ae ua leai se tasi na fasiotia—Ua lipoti mai e Kita le fasiotiga ma le sola'aga o pagota sa Lamanā. E tusa o le 63 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that I received an epistle from Ammoron, the king, stating that if I would deliver up those prisoners of war whom we had taken that he would deliver up the city of Antiparah unto us.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, sa oo ina ou maua se tusi mai ia Amorona, le tupu, fai mai e faapea afai ou te tuu atu pagota ia o le taua o e na matou ave, o le a ia tuu mai le aai o Anetipara ia te i matou.

verses.en: But I sent an epistle unto the king, that we were sure our forces were sufficient to take the city of Antiparah by our force; and by delivering up the prisoners for that city we should suppose ourselves unwise, and that we would only deliver up our prisoners on exchange.
verses.sm: Peitai sa ou auina atu se tusi i le tupu, ua matou mautinoa ua lava a matou autau e ave faamalosi ai le aai o Anetipara; ma o le tuuina atu o pagota mo lena aai ua matou manatu ia i matou lava e le o se mea poto, ma ua nao le faafesuiai o pagota matou te tuu atu ai a matou pagota.

verses.en: And Ammoron refused mine epistle, for he would not exchange prisoners; therefore we began to make preparations to go against the city of Antiparah.
verses.sm: Ma sa le talia e Amorona lau tusi, ona sa musu o ia e faafesuiai pagota; o lea na matou amata ai ona faia o sauniuniga matou te o atu ai e faasaga i le aai o Anetipara.

verses.en: But the people of Antiparah did leave the city, and fled to their other cities, which they had possession of, to fortify them; and thus the city of Antiparah fell into our hands.
verses.sm: Peitai sa tuua e tagata o Anetipara le aai, ma sa sosola atu i isi o latou aai, ia sa latou mauaina, e tuiolo i latou; ma sa faapea ona pa’ū mai ai o le aai o Anetipara i o matou lima.

verses.en: And thus ended the twenty and eighth year of the reign of the judges.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona i’u o le tausaga e luasefulu ma le valu o le nofoaiga a faamasino.

verses.en: And it came to pass that in the commencement of the twenty and ninth year, we received a supply of provisions, and also an addition to our army, from the land of Zarahemla, and from the land round about, to the number of six thousand men, besides sixty of the sons of the Ammonites who had come to join their brethren, my little band of two thousand. And now behold, we were strong, yea, and we had also plenty of provisions brought unto us.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le amataga o le tausaga e luasefulu ma le iva, sa matou maua ai se oloa o mea manaomia, ma se faaopoopoga foi i la matou autau, mai le laueleele o Sara’emila, ma mai i le laueleele faataamilo, i le aofai o le ono afe alii, e ese mai i le onosefulu o atalii o sa Amonā, o e na o mai e faatasi ma o latou uso, o la’u au toaitiiti lea e lua afe. Ma o lenei faauta, sa matou malolosi, ioe, ma sa matou maua foi le tele o mea manaomia na aumai ia te i matou.

w.en: which is the my little band

verses.en: And it came to pass that it was our desire to wage a battle with the army which was placed to protect the city Cumeni.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina matou mananao e tau se taua ma le autau lea sa tuu e puipuia le aai o Kumenae.

verses.en: And now behold, I will show unto you that we soon accomplished our desire; yea, with our strong force, or with a part of our strong force, we did surround, by night, the city Cumeni, a little before they were to receive a supply of provisions.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, o le a ou faaali atu ia te oe sa lei umi ae matou faataunuuina lo matou faamoemoe; ioe, faatasi ma la matou autau malosi, pe faatasi ma se vaega o la matou autau malosi, sa matou siomia ai, i le po, le aai o Kumenae, i se taimi puupuu ae lei oo i le taimi sa faapea o le a latou maua ai se oloa o mea manaomia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that we did camp round about the city for many nights; but we did sleep upon our swords, and keep guards, that the Lamanites could not come upon us by night and slay us, which they attempted many times; but as many times as they attempted this their blood was spilt.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina matou tolauapi faataamilo i le aai mo le tele o po; ae sa matou momoe ma a matou pelu, ma faatutū ni leoleo, ina ia le mafai ona o mai sa Lamanā i luga o i matou i le po ma fasioti i matou, o se mea sa latou taumafaia i le tele o taimi; peitai o le tele o taimi na latou taumafaia ai lenei mea na faamasaa ai o latou toto.

verses.en: At length their provisions did arrive, and they were about to enter the city by night. And we, instead of being Lamanites, were Nephites; therefore, we did take them and their provisions.
verses.sm: Ina ua mavae se taimi, sa oo ina taunuu ane a latou meaai, ma sa toeitiiti o latou ulu ane i le aai i le po. Ae o i matou, ua le o ni sa Lamanā, ae o ni sa Nifaē; o lea, na matou ave ai i latou ma a latou meaai.

verses.en: And notwithstanding the Lamanites being cut off from their support after this manner, they were still determined to maintain the city; therefore it became expedient that we should take those provisions and send them to Judea, and our prisoners to the land of Zarahemla.
verses.sm: Ma e ui ina vavae ese sa Lamanā mai mea e tausi ai i latou i lenei ala, sa latou gauai pea e taofi le aai; o lea sa tatau ai ona matou ave o ia meaai ma auina atu i Iutaia, ma a matou pagota i le laueleele o Sara’emila.

verses.en: And it came to pass that not many days had passed away before the Lamanites began to lose all hopes of succor; therefore they yielded up the city unto our hands; and thus we had accomplished our designs in obtaining the city Cumeni.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa lei tele ni aso na mavae, ae amata ona aveese o faamoemoega uma o sa Lamanā mo se fesoasoani; o lea na latou faamatuu mai ai le aai i o matou lima; ma sa faapea ona matou faataunuuina o a matou fuafuaga mo le mauaina o le aai o Kumenae.

verses.en: But it came to pass that our prisoners were so numerous that, notwithstanding the enormity of our numbers, we were obliged to employ all our force to keep them, or to put them to death.
verses.sm: Peitai sa oo ina matuā toatele na’uā a matou pagota, e ui i le toatele o lo matou aofai, sa tatau ia i matou ona faaaoga la matou autau atoa e leoleo i latou, po o le fasioti o i latou.

verses.en: For behold, they would break out in great numbers, and would fight with stones, and with clubs, or whatsoever thing they could get into their hands, insomuch that we did slay upwards of two thousand of them after they had surrendered themselves prisoners of war.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, e sosola i fafo le toatele o i latou, ma tau i maa, ma uatogi, po o soo se mea sa mafai ona latou uu i o latou lima, sa oo ina matou fasiotia ai le sili atu i le lua afe o i latou ina ua uma ona latou faamatuu mai o i latou lava o ni pagota o taua.

verses.en: Therefore it became expedient for us, that we should put an end to their lives, or guard them, sword in hand, down to the land of Zarahemla; and also our provisions were not any more than sufficient for our own people, notwithstanding that which we had taken from the Lamanites.
verses.sm: O lea sa tatau ai ia i matou, ona matou faaumaina o latou ola, pe leoleo i latou, ma le pelu i le lima, i lalo i le laueleele o Sara’emila; ma o a matou meaai foi sa le sili atu mai mea sa lava mo o matou lava tagata, e ui i meaai ia na matou avea mai ia sa Lamanā.

verses.en: And now, in those critical circumstances, it became a very serious matter to determine concerning these prisoners of war; nevertheless, we did resolve to send them down to the land of Zarahemla; therefore we selected a part of our men, and gave them charge over our prisoners to go down to the land of Zarahemla.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, i ia tulaga ogaoga, sa avea ai ma mataupu mamafa tele le filifili o se mea e tatau ona fai e uiga i nei pagota o le taua; ae ui i lea, sa tonu ia i matou e auina atu i latou i lalo i le laueleele o Sara’emila; o lea na matou filifilia ai se vaega o a matou tagata, ma tuu atu ia i latou le vaaiga o a matou pagota e o ifo i le laueleele o Sara’emila.

verses.en: But it came to pass that on the morrow they did return. And now behold, we did not inquire of them concerning the prisoners; for behold, the Lamanites were upon us, and they returned in season to save us from falling into their hands. For behold, Ammoron had sent to their support a new supply of provisions and also a numerous army of men.
verses.sm: Ae sa oo i le aso na sosoo ai, sa latou toe foi mai. Ma o lenei faauta, sa matou lei fesili atu ia i latou e uiga i pagota; aua faauta, sa oo mai sa Lamanā i o matou luga, ma sa latou foi tonu mai lava i le taimi e laveai ai i matou mai le pa’u’ū atu i o latou lima. Aua faauta, sa auina mai e Amorona mo lo latou lagolagoina se oloa fou o mea manaomia ma se autau toatele foi o tane.

verses.en: And it came to pass that those men whom we sent with the prisoners did arrive in season to check them, as they were about to overpower us.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina taunuu mai tagata ia o e na matou auina atu faatasi ma pagota i le taimi tonu lava e taofia ai i latou, ae toetoe o latou faatoilaloina i matou.

verses.en: But behold, my little band of two thousand and sixty fought most desperately; yea, they were firm before the Lamanites, and did administer death unto all those who opposed them.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa tau ma le aunoa ma se manatu i le oti si a’u au laiti e lua afe onosefulu; ioe, sa latou tutumau i luma o sa Lamanā, ma faaoo atu le oti ia te i latou uma o e na faasaga mai ia te i latou.

verses.en: And as the remainder of our army were about to give way before the Lamanites, behold, those two thousand and sixty were firm and undaunted.
verses.sm: Ma ina o le a solomuli le vaega na totoe o la matou autau mai luma o sa Lamanā, faauta, o lena lua afe ma le onosefulu sa tutumau ma le le faavaivai.

verses.en: Yea, and they did obey and observe to perform every word of command with exactness; yea, and even according to their faith it was done unto them; and I did remember the words which they said unto me that their mothers had taught them.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma sa latou usiusitai ma tausisi e fai upu uma o poloaiga ma le sa’o atoatoa; ioe, ma sa faia ia te i latou e tusa ma lo latou faatuatua; ma sa ou manatua upu na latou fai mai ia te a’u sa a’oa’oina ai i latou e o latou tinā.

verses.en: And now behold, it was these my sons, and those men who had been selected to convey the prisoners, to whom we owe this great victory; for it was they who did beat the Lamanites; therefore they were driven back to the city of Manti.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei faauta, o ou atalii nei, ma tagata ia o e na filifilia e ave pagota, o i latou ia ua matou nonofo aitalafu i ai mo lenei manumalo tele; ona o i latou ia o e na faatoilaloina sa Lamanā; o lea na toe tutuli ai i latou i tua i le aai o Maneti.

verses.en: And we retained our city Cumeni, and were not all destroyed by the sword; nevertheless, we had suffered great loss.
verses.sm: Ma sa matou taofia lo tatou aai o Kumenae, ma sa lei faaumatiaina uma i matou i le pelu; ae ui i lea, sa matou mafatia i le toatele o e na fasiotia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that after the Lamanites had fled, I immediately gave orders that my men who had been wounded should be taken from among the dead, and caused that their wounds should be dressed.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona sosola ese o sa Lamanā, sa vave ona ou tuu atu o ni faatonuga ia aveese mai totonu o tagata oti o’u tagata o e na manunua, ma faatonu atu ia fusifusia o latou manua.

verses.en: And it came to pass that there were two hundred, out of my two thousand and sixty, who had fainted because of the loss of blood; nevertheless, according to the goodness of God, and to our great astonishment, and also the joy of our whole army, there was not one soul of them who did perish; yea, and neither was there one soul among them who had not received many wounds.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa i ai le toalua selau, mai la’u lua afe ma le onosefulu, o e na matapogia ona o le tele o le toto masaa; ae ui i lea, e tusa ma le agalelei o le Atua, ma lo matou ofo tele, ma le olioli foi o la matou autau atoa, sa leai se tagata e toatasi o i latou na fano; ioe, pe sa i ai foi se tagata e toatasi i totonu o i latou sa lei oo i ai ni manua e tele.

verses.en: And now, their preservation was astonishing to our whole army, yea, that they should be spared while there was a thousand of our brethren who were slain. And we do justly ascribe it to the miraculous power of God, because of their exceeding faith in that which they had been taught to believe—that there was a just God, and whosoever did not doubt, that they should be preserved by his marvelous power.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, o lo latou faasaoina, o se mea sa ofoofogia tele i la matou autau atoa, ioe, i le faasaoina o i latou ae sa i ai se afe o o tatou uso o e na fasiotia. Ma ua matou tuuina tonu lava lenei mea i le mana faavavega o le Atua, ona o lo latou faatuatua tele i ia mea sa aoaoina i latou ia talitonu i ai— e faapea o loo i ai se Atua faamasinotonu, ma o soo se tasi e le masalosalo, o le a faasaoina i latou i lona mana faavavega.

verses.en: Now this was the faith of these of whom I have spoken; they are young, and their minds are firm, and they do put their trust in God continually.
verses.sm: O lenei o le faatuatua lenei o i latou nei o e ua ou tautala atu ai; ua talavou i latou, ma ua mausali o latou mafaufau, ma ua latou tuu atu o latou faalagolago i le Atua e le aunoa.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that after we had thus taken care of our wounded men, and had buried our dead and also the dead of the Lamanites, who were many, behold, we did inquire of Gid concerning the prisoners whom they had started to go down to the land of Zarahemla with.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina ua uma ona faapea ona matou tausi o a matou tagata na manunua, ma tanu o matou tagata oti ma tagata oti foi o sa Lamanā, o e sa toatele lava, faauta, sa matou fesili atu ia Kita e uiga i pagota o e na amata ona latou o ifo faatasi i lalo i le laueleele o Sara’emila.

verses.en: Now Gid was the chief captain over the band who was appointed to guard them down to the land.
verses.sm: O lenei o Kita o le kapeteni sili lea i luga o le vaega na tofia e leoleo i latou e o atu i le laueleele o Sara’emila.

verses.en: And now, these are the words which Gid said unto me: Behold, we did start to go down to the land of Zarahemla with our prisoners. And it came to pass that we did meet the spies of our armies, who had been sent out to watch the camp of the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, o upu nei na fai mai ai Kita ia te a’u: Faauta, sa amata ona matou o ifo i le laueleele o Sara’emila faatasi ma a tatou pagota. Ma sa oo ina matou fetaiai ma sipai o a tatou autau, o e na auina atu e vaavaai le togalauapi a sa Lamanā.

verses.en: And they cried unto us, saying—Behold, the armies of the Lamanites are marching towards the city of Cumeni; and behold, they will fall upon them, yea, and will destroy our people.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou tagi mai ia te i matou, e faapea: Faauta, o loo savavali atu nei le autau a sa Lamanā agai atu i le aai o Kumenae; ma faauta, o le a latou osofaia i latou, ioe, ma o le a faaumatiaina o tatou tagata.

verses.en: And it came to pass that our prisoners did hear their cries, which caused them to take courage; and they did rise up in rebellion against us.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina lagona atu e a matou pagota la latou tagi mai, lea na latou lototetele ai; ma latou tutulai ai e fouvale faasaga mai ia te i matou.

w.en: it came to pass that hear

verses.en: And it came to pass because of their rebellion we did cause that our swords should come upon them. And it came to pass that they did in a body run upon our swords, in the which, the greater number of them were slain; and the remainder of them broke through and fled from us.
verses.sm: Ma ona o lo latou fouvale, o lea na matou faia ai ia oo atu a matou pelu i luga o i latou. Ma sa oo ina latou taufetuli mai o se vaega e tasi i a matou pelu, o se mea na fasiotia ai le toatele o i latou; ma o e na totoe o i latou, na matalatala mai ma sosola ese atu mai ia i matou.

verses.en: And behold, when they had fled and we could not overtake them, we took our march with speed towards the city Cumeni; and behold, we did arrive in time that we might assist our brethren in preserving the city.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ina ua latou sosola, ma le mafai ona matou maua o i latou, o lea na faanatinati ai ona sau o la matou savaliga agai mai i le aai o Kumenae; ma faauta, na matou taunuu tonu mai lava i le taimi na mafai ai ona matou fesoasoani i o tatou uso i le faasaoina o le aai.

verses.en: And behold, we are again delivered out of the hands of our enemies. And blessed is the name of our God; for behold, it is he that has delivered us; yea, that has done this great thing for us.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ua toe laveaiina foi i tatou mai lima o o tatou fili. Ma ia faamanūina lava le suafa o lo tatou Atua; aua faauta, o ia lava na laveaiina i tatou; ioe, o ia lava na ia faia lenei mea sili mo i tatou.

verses.en: Now it came to pass that when I, Helaman, had heard these words of Gid, I was filled with exceeding joy because of the goodness of God in preserving us, that we might not all perish; yea, and I trust that the souls of them who have been slain have entered into the rest of their God.
verses.sm: O lenei sa oo ina ua uma ona faalogo atu o a’u, o Helamana, i nei upu a Kita, sa faatumuina a’u i le olioli tele ona o le agalelei o le Atua i le faasaoina o i matou, ina ia le fano uma i matou; ioe, ma ou te faamoemoe o agaga o i latou o e ua fasiotia ua ulufale atu i le malologa o lo latou Atua.
